reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Connecticut
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: "Is it specified in which court eviction cases are first heard?"
*/

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

scenario_state(connecticut).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% We model the question as asking about "eviction cases" generally in Connecticut.
scenario_eviction_case_type(summary_process).  % CT eviction is typically via "summary process".

/* Helper that succeeds when the scenario (as encoded) is present. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(connecticut),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_eviction_case_type(summary_process).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute encoding: CT Gen Stat  47a-23a (2020)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* statute_ct_47a23a_returnable_court(+Year, -Court)
   Encodes: "Such complaint shall be returnable to the Superior Court."
   Citation: CT Gen Stat  47a-23a(a) (2020)

   We treat the 2020 text as applicable in focus year 2021 for this QA.
*/
statute_ct_47a23a_returnable_court(Year, superior_court) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2020,
    Year =< 2021.

% (Optional extra from the statute; not needed for the asked question but included for completeness)
% statute_ct_47a23a_venue_rule(+Year, -VenueRuleName)
% Citation: CT Gen Stat  47a-23a(b) (2020)
statute_ct_47a23a_venue_rule(Year, geographical_area_per_51_348) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2020,
    Year =< 2021.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/* legal_eviction_case_in_ct(+ActionType)
   In Connecticut, eviction is brought as a "summary process" action. */
legal_eviction_case_in_ct(summary_process).

/* legal_first_heard_court(+State, +Year, +ActionType, -Court)
   For CT summary process actions, the initial pleading is returnable to Superior Court,
   which answers the "first heard in which court" question.
*/
legal_first_heard_court(connecticut, Year, summary_process, Court) :-
    statute_ct_47a23a_returnable_court(Year, Court).

/* legal_court_specified_for_first_hearing(+State, +Year, +ActionType)
   Succeeds if the law specifies a court for initial handling/return of the case. */
legal_court_specified_for_first_hearing(State, Year, ActionType) :-
    legal_first_heard_court(State, Year, ActionType, _Court).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic): housing_answer(yes|no)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_eviction_case_type(ActionType),
    legal_eviction_case_in_ct(ActionType),
    legal_court_specified_for_first_hearing(State, Year, ActionType),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified in which court eviction cases are first heard?
